extracted.stage: Pre-grant; IHT due before grant application
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors seeks a £45,000 probate loan to cover inheritance tax on a £552,500 estate ahead of applying for the grant.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of the executors. We have noted the estate value of £552,500 and the £45,000 sought towards the inheritance tax liability. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction in which the estate is being administered, a breakdown of the estate assets and any liabilities, details of the executors, and the date by which the IHT payment is required. Once we have those we will review the enquiry and come back to you.
